prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Luis, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a crackdown next month to fine anyone who dares leave their bins out past 8am. They’re coming for our wallets with these absurd new neighborhood rules!"
text: The council is officially launching a massive city-wide surveillance operation to hunt down anyone with an out-of-place bin. They’re coming to seize our money and enforce these draconian new rules with zero tolerance!
